request.query: number of functions choosing an element of a finite set at every coordinate equals a product

items.name: Finset.card_pi
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_4} {α : ι → Type u_6} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (t : (i : ι) → Finset (α i)),
  (s.pi t).card = ∏ i ∈ s, (t i).card

items.name: Nat.card_fun
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [Finite α], Nat.card (α → β) = Nat.card β ^ Nat.card α

items.name: Fintype.card_filter_piFinset_eq_of_mem
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_4} {α : ι → Type u_6} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : (i : ι) → DecidableEq (α i)]
  (s : (i : ι) → Finset (α i)) (i : ι) {a : α i},
  a ∈ s i → {f ∈ Fintype.piFinset s | f i = a}.card = ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (s j).card

items.name: Fintype.card_pi_const
items.type: ∀ (α : Type u_7) [inst : Fintype α] (n : ℕ), Fintype.card (Fin n → α) = Fintype.card α ^ n

items.name: Fintype.card_filter_piFinset_const_eq_of_mem
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_4} {κ : Type u_5} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq κ] [inst_2 : Fintype ι] (s : Finset κ)
  (i : ι) {x : κ}, x ∈ s → {f ∈ Fintype.piFinset fun x => s | f i = x}.card = s.card ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1)
